vehicles.duplicates.reason.makeModelYear: The make, model and year of manufacture are also the same.
vehicles.duplicates.reason.plate: One of these vehicles now carries a number plate that the other one used to carry.
vehicles.duplicates.reason.vin: The two chassis numbers differ by only one character, which usually means someone mistyped one of them.
vehicles.duplicates.scanNote: This page lists what the system has already noticed. It does not go looking for new pairs while you are reading — that happens separately, and every run is recorded.
vehicles.duplicates.title: Review duplicate vehicles
vehicles.ev.canRecord: You can record them from this vehicle.
vehicles.ev.heading: Electric drive
vehicles.ev.highVoltage: High-voltage safety warning is recorded for this vehicle.
vehicles.ev.notApplicable: This vehicle is not recorded as electric or hybrid, so there are no electric-drive details.
vehicles.ev.notRecordedYet: No electric-drive details have been recorded for this vehicle.
vehicles.ev.readFailed: The electric-drive details could not be loaded.
vehicles.ev.scopeNote: These are the details recorded on the vehicle. No battery health or range estimate is calculated here.
vehicles.history.heading: Change history
vehicles.history.noDetail: Changed; the values are not shown here.
vehicles.history.scopeNote: Changes to this vehicle’s own details. Owners, plates, odometer readings and linked vehicles each have their own tab.
vehicles.media.blocked: Vehicle photos and media are not available yet. Accepted file types, size limits and storage are pending an Owner decision, and nothing is uploaded or stored until it is made.
vehicles.media.heading: Photos and media
vehicles.odometer.caption: Odometer readings
vehicles.odometer.heading: Odometer
vehicles.odometer.note: Newest first. Readings are shown exactly as recorded, in the unit they were taken in.
vehicles.ownership.caption: Ownership history
vehicles.ownership.heading: Ownership
vehicles.ownership.kindHint: Leave blank to record a registered owner.
vehicles.ownership.note: Newest first. "In force" means the period has started and has not ended; an entry that starts later is not in force yet.
vehicles.plate.caption: Registration plate history
vehicles.plate.heading: Plates
vehicles.plate.note: Plates are shown in their normalised form, which is what search matches. Only one plate is in force at a time.
vehicles.profile.chooseAStatus: Choose at least one status to change.
vehicles.profile.frozenNote: This vehicle was merged into another record. It is kept for history and can no longer be changed.
vehicles.profile.noConcurrencyNote: If someone else edits this vehicle at the same time, the last save wins and you will not be warned.
vehicles.create.conflict: One of the values you entered is already used by another vehicle. Check the VIN and the reference number.
vehicles.profile.terminalNote: This vehicle is scrapped. You can still correct its details, but its status, plates, owners, authorised people and battery details can no longer change.
vehicles.profile.title: Vehicle
vehicles.relationships.caption: Vehicle relationships
vehicles.relationships.heading: People and organisations
vehicles.relationships.linkRoleHint: To authorise someone to act for this vehicle, use “Authorise a customer” below instead — that is where the permitted actions are chosen.
vehicles.relationships.manageNote: Authorised parties appear in this list. There is no separate list, so anyone who can add one may not always be able to see it here.
vehicles.relationships.retireConfirm: This ends the customer’s authorisation for this vehicle. The record stays in the history.
vehicles.relationships.retireHint: Leave blank to end it today.
vehicles.relationships.scopeExplainer: Only an authorised person carries a list of permitted actions. Every other role is a relationship, not a permission.
vehicles.search.caption: Vehicle search results
vehicles.search.description: Find a vehicle by VIN, plate or reference.
vehicles.search.exactMatchNote: VIN, plate and reference are matched exactly — partial values return nothing. Plate matches the current plate only.
vehicles.search.idleBody: Enter a VIN, plate or vehicle reference and choose Search. Results are not loaded until you do.
vehicles.search.needCriteria: Enter at least one search value.
vehicles.search.plateHint: Exact match, current plate only. A previous plate will not match.
vehicles.search.title: Vehicles
vehicles.search.vinHint: Exact match. Punctuation and spacing are ignored.
vehicles.vin.available: No other vehicle in your organisation uses this VIN.
vehicles.vin.checkUnavailable: The check could not run, so this VIN has not been confirmed either way.
vehicles.vin.duplicate: Another vehicle in your organisation already uses this VIN.
vehicles.vin.noAlphanumeric: A VIN must contain at least one letter or digit.
vehicles.vin.nonStandardLength: This is not the usual 17 characters. That is allowed and will be saved as entered.
vehicles.vin.tooLong: This VIN is longer than the maximum allowed.
crm.customers.addresses.countryHint: Two-letter country code, for example JO or AE. Leave it empty if you do not know it.
vehicles.plate.countryHint: Two or three letters, for example JO or UAE.
vehicles.plate.effectiveFromHint: Leave empty to start today. A future date schedules the change.
vehicles.plate.error.country: Use the two or three letter country code.
vehicles.odometer.observedAtHint: When the reading was taken, for example 2026-03-01T09:30:00Z.
vehicles.odometer.captureMethodHint: Where the reading came from. Ignored when an earlier reading is being corrected — a correction is recorded as one.
vehicles.odometer.correctionOfHint: Leave empty to record a new reading. Choosing a reading listed above records a correction to it instead; the original stays in the history.
vehicles.odometer.correctionReasonHint: Required whenever a reading is being corrected.
vehicles.odometer.error.observedAt: Give the date and time the reading was taken.
vehicles.odometer.error.correctionOf: Choose one of the readings listed above.
vehicles.odometer.error.reasonRequired: Give the reason this reading is being corrected.
vehicles.odometer.error.reasonWithoutRea: A reason belongs to a correction. Choose the reading being corrected, or clear this to record an ordinary reading.
vehicles.ev.capacityHint: Usable battery capacity in kWh. Leave empty if it is not known.
receptions.checkIn.title: Vehicle check-in
receptions.checkIn.description: Open a reception visit for a vehicle, or resume the visit that is already open.
receptions.checkIn.targetHint: The visit is opened for one branch. The server authorizes this request against exactly the branch named here.
receptions.checkIn.scopeUnrestricted: Your account is not restricted to specific branches, so enter the identifier directly.
receptions.checkIn.originHint: A visit has exactly one origin: a confirmed appointment being checked in, or a walk-in.
receptions.checkIn.walkInDescription: The customer arrived without a booking.
receptions.checkIn.appointmentDescriptio: Check in a confirmed appointment. The appointment becomes checked-in in the same step.
receptions.checkIn.appointmentsDenied: Your account cannot read the appointment calendar, so an appointment origin cannot be chosen here.
receptions.checkIn.targetFirst: Choose the company and branch first.
receptions.checkIn.noConfirmedAppointmen: No confirmed appointments for this branch.
receptions.checkIn.customersDenied: Your account cannot search customers, so a walk-in requester cannot be chosen here.
receptions.checkIn.noCustomerVehicles: This customer has no recorded vehicles. Link the vehicle to the customer from the vehicle screen first.
receptions.checkIn.handoffApplied: Continued from walk-in intake. The customer and vehicle recorded there are already selected — check them before opening the visit.
receptions.checkIn.handoffVehicleMissing: Continued from walk-in intake, but that vehicle is not in this customer's list. Choose the vehicle below.
receptions.checkIn.openVisitTitle: This vehicle already has an open visit
receptions.checkIn.employeeDirectoryScop: Choosing another user searches the whole workspace user directory — every account, with its address and status — because that is what the user-read permission opens and no narrower staff list is published. The same permission already loads your own session, so this control widens no access; it reuses what signing in required.
receptions.checkIn.employeeHint: The platform records an identifier for the receiving employee. No employee register exists yet (open decision G-EMP), so the candidates offered are platform users and the recorded value is an identifier, not an employee-register entry.
receptions.checkIn.fuelUnavailable: The fuel-level catalogue could not be read. The visit can be opened without it.
receptions.checkIn.fuelEmpty: No fuel levels are configured yet. The visit can be opened without one.
receptions.checkIn.evSocHint: State of charge from 0 to 100. Decimals are allowed.
receptions.checkIn.createDenied: Opening a visit needs the reception management permission. You can still resume an open visit from its link.
receptions.checkIn.conflictBody: The platform refused to open this visit: the vehicle already has an open visit, or this origin was already used to check in. The answer does not say which.
receptions.checkIn.error.appointmentRequ: Choose the appointment being checked in.
receptions.checkIn.error.socInvalid: The EV charge must be a number.
receptions.wizard.title: Check-in wizard
receptions.wizard.receivingEmployeeNote: The receiving employee is recorded as an identifier. No employee register exists yet (open decision G-EMP), so no name can be shown honestly.
receptions.wizard.terminalNote: The record stays readable; nothing more can be written to it.
receptions.steps.confirm.title: Customer and vehicle
receptions.steps.confirm.description: Confirm who is here and which vehicle is on the ramp before anything is captured.
receptions.steps.parties.title: Parties and authorization
receptions.steps.parties.description: Record who is present in which role, and the authorization decisions they gave.
receptions.steps.media.title: Photographs and media
receptions.steps.media.description: What would be recorded here, why it is not, and what the Owner must decide.
receptions.media.heading: Media capture is not available
receptions.media.surface.evidence: This is where the photographs taken at the desk would be recorded against the visit.
receptions.media.surface.damageMap: A damage map needs a template document and its exact version. Neither can be produced in this release, so marks cannot be placed on one.
receptions.media.surface.signature: A signature record needs a signature image and its exact version. Neither can be produced in this release.
receptions.media.blocked: Capture is blocked. Nothing on this screen takes, chooses or records a picture or a file, and no control is offered for doing so.
receptions.media.decisionLabel: Blocked by an open Owner decision:
receptions.media.decide.set: Which pictures a reception must carry, and which views make up the exterior set.
receptions.media.decide.formats: Which file kinds are accepted, and the ceiling on how large a file may be.
receptions.media.decide.storage: Where the files are held, in which region, and how long they are kept.
receptions.media.decide.enforcement: Whether missing pictures prevent a reception from being approved.
receptions.media.afterDecision: Once that decision is recorded, this area will register media against the visit and show the state of every item on the list.
receptions.media.ceiling: Even then, the truthful state of a registered file is pending: there is no storage provider and no file scan yet, so nothing can be retrieved back out.
receptions.confirm.noRequesterRole: No active service-requester role is recorded on this visit.
receptions.confirm.vehicleMerged: This vehicle record was merged into another record. It remains readable, and the surviving record is linked below.
receptions.confirm.linkRecorded: This vehicle is recorded among the requester's vehicles.
receptions.confirm.linkAbsent: No active link between this requester and this vehicle is recorded. That is a fact to note, not an error.
receptions.confirm.linkUnknown: Whether a link is recorded could not be determined.
receptions.confirm.relationshipsEmpty: No parties are recorded on this vehicle.
receptions.confirm.proceedNote: There is no confirm operation to call: confirming is reading this step and moving on. Evidence capture follows in the next steps.
receptions.parties.rolesEmpty: No party roles are recorded yet.
receptions.parties.rolesReadOnly: Recording party roles needs the party-management permission.
receptions.parties.needsCustomerRead: This form needs the customer-read permission to name a partner.
receptions.parties.sourceHint: Where this assignment came from, e.g. front desk.
receptions.parties.supersede: Close the previous assignment in the same role first
receptions.parties.supersedeHint: Asked for explicitly: closing history silently would re-date it.
receptions.authorization.heading: Authorization
receptions.authorization.empty: No authorization decisions or refusals are recorded yet.
receptions.authorization.readOnly: Recording a decision needs the authorization-verification permission.
receptions.authorization.hint: Approval and decline are both first-class records. A declined decision stands until the same party approves later.
receptions.authorization.roleHint: Only roles that carry authority to approve work are offered. Driving or paying is not authority to approve.
receptions.authorization.conflict: The platform refused this record. The visit state, or the partner's roles, does not allow it; the answer deliberately does not say which.
receptions.steps.complaints.title: Customer concerns
receptions.steps.complaints.description: What the customer reported, in their own words.
receptions.steps.inspection.title: Inspection and findings
receptions.steps.inspection.description: What the workshop observed: inspection findings and visible leaks.
receptions.steps.damage.title: Damage map and marks
receptions.steps.damage.description: Where the damage is, placed on the vehicle diagram.
receptions.steps.readings.title: Arrival readings
receptions.steps.readings.description: Odometer, fuel level and state of charge on arrival.
receptions.steps.warningLights.title: Warning lights
receptions.steps.contents.title: Vehicle contents
receptions.steps.contents.description: What the customer left in the vehicle, as declared.
receptions.steps.signature.title: Signatures
receptions.steps.signature.description: What each party put their name to.
receptions.steps.refusal.title: Refusals
receptions.steps.refusal.description: A party declined a step. This does not end the visit.
receptions.evidence.restrictedReadBack: The stored text of these records is not returned by this read: it needs the sensitive-data permission. What is shown below is the record without its narrative.
receptions.evidence.readBackEmpty: Nothing of this kind has been recorded for this visit.
receptions.evidence.morePages: More records exist than are shown here.
receptions.evidence.sessionNote: Held in this browser only, so the text you typed stays visible. It is not read back from the server and it disappears when the page reloads.
receptions.evidence.conflict: This could not be recorded because the visit has moved on. The details above have been read again; check them and try once more.
receptions.evidence.lockedNote: This visit has ended, so nothing further can be recorded against it.
receptions.evidence.readOnly: You can read this evidence but not record any.
receptions.evidence.sensitiveRequired: Recording this needs permission to handle restricted customer information as well as permission to record evidence: the text is stored in a restricted table that the database will not write without it. The form is withheld rather than offered as something that could only be refused.
receptions.evidence.sensitiveDenied: This kind needs both permissions together — recording evidence and handling restricted customer information — each checked against this visit's company and branch. The refusal does not say which of them was missing, and this screen will not guess.
receptions.evidence.reporterNeedsCustome: Naming the person needs the customer-read permission. The record can still be saved without a name.
receptions.evidence.inspectionRequired: A finding is recorded against an open inspection, and this visit has none. Open an inspection above first.
receptions.evidence.damageMapBlocked: A damage map can only be opened against a registered map template and the exact version it was drawn on. Nothing in this product registers a document yet, and the file policy decision is still open, so no map can be opened here.
receptions.evidence.damageMapRequired: A mark is placed on a damage map, and this visit has none. Opening one is not available yet; the panel above says why.
receptions.evidence.warningCatalogueEmpt: The warning-light catalogue has no entries, so no lamp can be recorded. This is the catalogue answering correctly, not a failure.
receptions.complaint.heading: Concerns raised by the customer
receptions.complaint.customerWordsNote: Write what the customer said, in their words. A concern is not a technical finding; the workshop's own observations belong in the inspection step.
receptions.complaint.severityHint: How serious the customer said it was, not a technical assessment.
receptions.complaint.textHint: Recorded and kept as written. It is stored as restricted information.
receptions.inspection.heading: Inspections
receptions.inspection.openOnlyNote: A finding is recorded against an open inspection. There is no operation that closes one, so an inspection opened here stays open.
receptions.inspection.inspectorNote: The inspector is recorded as the signed-in user. The platform has no employee register, so no other name can be resolved for this field.
receptions.inspection.roadTestAbsent: Road test is not part of this release. No operation, status or report for one exists anywhere in the platform, so nothing here is offered as a road test.
receptions.finding.heading: Condition findings
receptions.finding.staffObservationNote: What the workshop observed. A customer's concern is a separate record and stays in the concerns step.
receptions.finding.inspectionHint: Only inspections still open can take a new finding.
receptions.finding.zoneHint: In your own words. The platform has no list of vehicle areas.
receptions.finding.error.inspectionRequi: Choose the inspection this finding belongs to.
receptions.finding.error.zoneRequired: Name the area of the vehicle.
receptions.leak.heading: Visible leaks
receptions.leak.observationNote: Recorded as observed. No cause and no responsibility is stated.
receptions.leak.typeHint: In your own words. The accepted values are decided by the database, not by a list on this screen.
receptions.damage.coordHint: A fraction of the map between 0 and 1, so the mark stays in place if the map is resized.
receptions.damage.diagramLabel: Place the mark on the diagram. Click to place it, or use the arrow keys once this has focus.
receptions.damage.error.coordRange: Give a horizontal and a vertical position between 0 and 1. Any precision is accepted; nothing is rounded.
receptions.damage.error.mapRequired: Choose the damage map this mark belongs to.
receptions.odometer.heading: Odometer
receptions.odometer.vehicleScopeNote: A reading recorded here is added to the vehicle's own odometer history. The reading this visit refers to is set when the visit is opened and cannot be changed afterwards.
receptions.odometer.needsVehicleRead: Reading the odometer history needs the vehicle-read permission.
receptions.odometer.empty: This vehicle has no recorded readings.
receptions.odometer.readOnly: You can read the odometer history but not record a reading.
receptions.odometer.correctionElsewhere: Correcting an earlier reading is done where that history is reviewed.
receptions.fuel.heading: Fuel level and state of charge
receptions.fuel.recordedSoc: State of charge recorded at check-in
receptions.fuel.notEditable: Both are recorded when the visit is opened. No operation changes them afterwards, so there is nothing to edit here.
receptions.fuel.catalogueHeading: Fuel levels available to choose at check-in
receptions.fuel.notConfigured: No fuel levels are configured. The list is empty, which is the catalogue answering correctly.
receptions.fuel.catalogueTruncated: The list was cut short; more entries exist than are shown.
receptions.warning.heading: Warning lights recorded
receptions.warning.noManagementRoute: There is no screen anywhere in this product for adding entries to that catalogue, so the gap cannot be closed from here.
receptions.warning.name: Lamp name
receptions.warning.observedStateHint: In your own words. The accepted values are decided by the database, not by a list on this screen.
receptions.warning.error.codeRequired: Choose the lamp that was showing.
receptions.contents.heading: Contents recorded
receptions.contents.formLabel: Declare an item left in the vehicle
receptions.contents.locationHint: For example, the glovebox or the boot.
receptions.contents.currencyHint: A three-letter code, and only meaningful with a declared value beside it.
receptions.contents.witnessedHint: Records you as the witness. The platform has no employee register, so no other name can be resolved for this field.
receptions.contents.error.quantity: The quantity must be a whole number greater than zero.
receptions.contents.error.declaredValue: The declared value must be zero or more, and within the allowed range.
receptions.contents.error.currencyFormat: The currency is a three-letter code.
receptions.contents.error.currencyWithou: A currency needs a declared value beside it. Add the value, or clear the currency.
receptions.signature.heading: Signatures
receptions.signature.blocked: A signature cannot be recorded yet. Recording one needs a registered signature document and the exact version that was signed, and nothing in this product registers a document.
receptions.signature.mediaState: Any file reference this platform holds is registered and pending. Nothing is stored, scanned, or made available to open.
receptions.signature.decision: The file policy decision is still open. This screen states the gap rather than offering a control that could not work.
receptions.signature.noReadBack: There is no operation that lists signatures, so a signature recorded by any other means is not visible here.
receptions.signature.rolesRecorded: Roles a signature can be attributed to
receptions.signature.hashBound: Maximum length of the signature hash
receptions.signature.partiesNote: The parties currently recorded against the visit — the people a signature would be attributed to.
receptions.refusal.heading: Refusals recorded
receptions.refusal.notTheExit: This records that a party declined a step. It does not change the state of the visit and does not end it — ending a visit is a separate command on the summary.
receptions.refusal.readBackLimits: Only a refusal of an authorization, attributed to a named party, can be read back. Other refusals are recorded and are not returned by any read this product has.
receptions.refusal.empty: No refusal of an authorization has been recorded for this visit.
receptions.refusal.readOnly: You can read refusals but not record one.
receptions.refusal.typeHint: Declining an authorization becomes that party’s standing answer until the same party approves later.
receptions.refusal.reasonsNotConfigured: No refusal reasons are configured. The list is empty, which is the catalogue answering correctly, and the reason is optional.
receptions.refusal.partnerNeedsCustomerR: Naming who declined needs the customer-read permission. A refusal of an authorization cannot be recorded without it.
receptions.refusal.witnessHint: Records you as the witness. The platform has no employee register, so no other name can be resolved for this field.
receptions.refusal.error.partnerRequired: A refusal of an authorization must name who declined.
receptions.steps.summary.title: Summary and approval
receptions.steps.summary.description: Read what is on record, then approve the visit so work can begin — or end it and release the vehicle.
receptions.steps.convert.title: Work order
receptions.steps.convert.description: Turn the authorized visit into a work order. This is the only way a work order comes to exist.
receptions.summary.partiesEmpty: No active party roles are recorded on this visit.
receptions.summary.authorizationsEmpty: No authorization decisions or refusals are recorded on this visit.
receptions.summary.evidenceEmpty: No condition evidence is recorded on this visit yet.
receptions.summary.evidenceTruncated: This is one page of the evidence. More is recorded than is shown here.
receptions.summary.notVerified: Not yet technically verified. Reception records what the customer reported and what staff observed; diagnosis is the technician’s work, later.
receptions.summary.complaintWordsRestric: The customer’s own wording is held on the restricted complaint record and is not part of this list.
receptions.summary.decisionClosed: This visit has ended, so no decision can be taken on it. What is above is the record.
receptions.summary.approveBody: Approving moves the visit to authorized, which is what lets work begin. It cannot be undone from here.
receptions.summary.approvedOneEdge: One step was applied: the visit moved straight to authorized.
receptions.summary.approvedTwoEdges: Two steps were applied in one transaction: the visit moved through inspecting to authorized.
receptions.summary.approveDenied: Approving a visit needs the reception approval permission.
receptions.summary.approveUnavailable: This visit cannot be approved from its current status.
receptions.summary.closeDenied: Ending a visit needs the reception closure permission.
receptions.closure.closeBody: End the visit without a work order and release the vehicle, so it can be received again.
receptions.closure.refuseBody: End the visit as refused and release the vehicle. This is the workshop declining the visit, not a party declining a step.
receptions.closure.reasonHint: Required. The reason is kept on the visit’s permanent record.
receptions.closure.error.reasonRequired: State the reason for ending this visit.
receptions.closure.error.reasonTooLong: The reason is longer than the record allows. Shorten it.
receptions.command.conflictStale: This visit changed while you were reading it. It has been read again — check what is shown and try once more.
receptions.command.conflictBlocked: The visit’s current state does not allow this command. Reading it again will not change that; what is shown now is the current record.
receptions.convert.heading: Convert to a work order
receptions.convert.body: An authorized visit becomes one work order. This is the only way a work order comes to exist; everything that happens to it afterwards belongs to the workshop screens.
receptions.convert.denied: Converting a visit needs the reception conversion permission.
receptions.convert.unavailable: A visit is converted once it is authorized. Approve it first.
receptions.convert.alreadyDone: This visit has already been converted to a work order.
receptions.convert.replayed: This visit was already converted. The work order below is the one it produced — nothing was created twice.
receptions.convert.stateOpaque: The state is a code from the workshop’s own catalogue, so it is shown exactly as recorded.
receptions.convert.readDenied: The work order exists. Your access does not include reading work orders, so only what the conversion answered is shown.
receptions.convert.noJobs: The work order has no jobs on it yet.
receptions.acknowledgement.title: Reception acknowledgement
receptions.acknowledgement.description: The visit record, laid out for printing and for handing to the customer.
receptions.acknowledgement.footerNote: This sheet records what was reported and observed when the vehicle was received. It is not a diagnosis and not a quotation.
receptions.acknowledgement.sectionUnread: This section could not be read, so it is not printed here. That is not a statement that nothing is recorded — quote this reference when asking about it:
receptions.acknowledgement.truncated: One page of this section is printed. More is recorded than fits here; the full list is on the visit screen.
receptions.queue.title: Reception queue
receptions.queue.description: The vehicles this branch has received, most recently received first.
receptions.queue.idleBody: The queue is read for one branch at a time. Name the company and branch, then show the queue.
receptions.queue.caption: Reception visits for the chosen branch
receptions.queue.noneMatching: No reception visit in this branch matches what you asked for.
receptions.queue.orderingNote: Ordered by when the vehicle was received, newest first. The platform publishes no total, so none is shown.
receptions.queue.releaseVehicle: Open the visit to end it
